name: Ewurabena's Chop Bar
description: One-page site for a chop bar behind Asafo market in Kumasi. Warm cream, palm-oil red and turmeric with Young Serif headings. A hero with a live open/closed pill, the week of soups with today's pair highlighted by Ghana-time weekday, a menu board with dotted leaders and GH₵ prices where + adds plates to an order panel that writes the order out and opens it on WhatsApp with total, pickup time and name, a food gallery, a funeral and party catering quote form, and a visit section with directions and hours.
